units.rawText: Daily patrol's not as dull as I imagined. Speeding along the boundless horizon of the Null Zone, with the wind blowing past me and no speed limit in sight.

units.rawText: So long as I have that, I'll never be lonely, with nothing but boundless joy in my heart. Of course, I would be more than willing to share that joy with a certain someone.

units.rawText: I think the Professor would be my first choice for a riding partner. With all of that from me, shouldn't you respond in kind just a little?
